plan: First playable: 3x3 tic-tac-toe against a kind AI with three levels and hot-seat play, plus ultimate tic-tac-toe unlocked after five wins. Online play and larger boards are left out.

First playable: a 1 to 50 path board with rope bridges and ladders where tapping the big die moves the piece with voiced counting, for one to four players. The 100-square board and history notes come later.
First playable: six animal families of four cards, two to four players with friendly AI that remembers asks, and a polite voiced ask on each turn. Custom families and online play are left out.
First playable: double-six dominoes against one gentle AI where matching dot counts glow at open chain ends and a tap places the domino. Scoring variants like Muggins and double-nine sets come later.
First playable: the club hub with reversi and four in a row against Rela at three kind levels, legal-move highlights and hot-seat play. Checkers and mancala are deferred to later updates.
First playable: three to five acorn piles against a gardener AI with deliberate kind mistakes, 12 guided positions and an optional binary view that reveals the XOR strategy. Misere Nim comes later.
First playable: a four-colour patterned race track where pieces sent back simply go home, tap-to-roll dice, highlighted legal moves and AI or hot-seat seats. Team and rule variants are left out.
First playable: Klondike and FreeCell with drag or tap moves, unlimited undo, auto-complete and a solver that offers winnable deals and next-move hints. Spider and daily challenges come later.
First playable: 10 layered layouts of original illustrated tiles where free matching pairs are tapped away, with solvable deals, shuffle and info cards for Chinese numerals. Timed modes are left out.
First playable: two-player rummy against one AI with numbered cards in four suits, drag-to-meld sets and runs, laying off and a planning hint. Joker variants and more players are left out.
First playable: Hex on 7x7 and 9x9 boards against a Monte Carlo AI with three levels, the swap rule, a highlighted winning chain and 10 teaching puzzles. Bigger boards and online play come later.
First playable: capture Go and 9x9 Go with liberty highlights, territory scoring, a gentle AI and 30 tutorial and life-and-death problems. 13x13 and 19x19 boards are deferred.

First playable: full chess rules with friendly piece characters that go home when captured, 20 mini-game lessons per piece, a kind AI with hints and short history cards. Openings library and clocks are left out.

First playable: one island board with rising water cards, four rescuer roles with special actions, AI or hot-seat teammates and 6 scenarios of growing difficulty. Online co-op and a map editor are left out.

First playable: full backgammon on an original woodland board with highlighted legal destinations, bearing off, an expectiminimax AI and 8 lessons on dice odds. The doubling cube and match play are left out.
First playable: four-player Hearts with leaf suits against three woodland AI players, passing, a played-cards tracker and gentle advice. Shooting the moon variants and online play are left out.
First playable: four-seat cooperative trick-taking with numbered signal cards, one limited signal per player, AI crewmates that read signals and 20 research missions. Online crews are left out.

First playable: one mountain expedition of a branching map with weather, rope and shelter cards, a 60-card pool to draft from and 12 encounter types, with no combat or gambling. More regions and characters are deferred.
